verification_scope: Read-only native Windows window discovery and selected-window UIA capture with screenshots disabled

sandbox_observation.verification_execution_context: Authorized unsandboxed client connected to the official daemon on the interactive desktop

observed_operations.case: window belongs to a different pid

observed_operations.response_shape: JSON-RPC result containing content and structuredContent; isError absent

sanitization.process_and_window_ids: Consistent numeric replacements preserve types and relationships; not reusable live identifiers
sanitization.list_windows: Two Explorer records retained from twelve; the same records retained in _legacy_windows
sanitization.get_accessibility_tree: One Explorer process and its two windows retained from 348 processes and twelve windows
sanitization.private_window_titles: File Explorer folder title replaced with a string placeholder
sanitization.native_tree: Nonsensitive standard desktop labels and original structure retained

limitations: Native reading was verified on one existing Explorer Program Manager window; coverage for other applications depends on their UIA providers.
No GUI applications were launched, activated, clicked, typed into, or edited for verification.
No browser execution methods or screenshots were used.
The desktop must remain accessible to the service; the Codex sandbox itself exposes a separate empty desktop.
elements contains indexed rows, while unindexed ancestors can appear only in tree_markdown.
elements_complete was false on all observed Windows tree responses.
Input-validation failures can have CLI process exit code 0 and non-JSON stdout; MCP preserves the tool-error envelope.
